## Glossary

**anticipated**  
Primary measure: share of real corrections some Warden said first.

**charter eval**  
scripts/evals/warden-charter.ts: runs a classify configuration over probes and judges the remarks; a dev diagnostic.

**classify run config**  
run.json given to --classify: stages, eval-only sections, debug, members; read by readClassifyRun.

**correction target**  
What a correction pushed toward (rule, primitive, system, pattern) labelled by --label-targets (Opus).

**cost weights**  
kindWeighted / modelWeighted: tokens weighted by kind and model into comparable cost.

**experiment gate**  
requireExperiment / experimentProblems: a wide eval run needs a passing experiment design.

**judge**  
Judges one Warden remark with the provider, retrying a failed call up to twice.

**markEvalRun**  
Marks a process and state dir as an eval run so Archive and repeat reports skip it.

**Oracle**  
The replay test of Wardens; scores with the same foundry-core code as the charter eval.

**probe**  
A moment from a real session: the user's ask, the agent's turn, the correction, and a train/test period; never committed.

**silence precision**  
NO_COMMENT when nothing of the Warden's applied.

**speak precision**  
A remark matched the user's later real correction, judged by Opus.

**warden-evals**  
Class: Warden eval machinery: probes, labels, charter runs, classify run configs, judging, cost weights, reports, the experiment gate.

**warden-prefilter**  
Class: the rule that there is no Warden pre-filter; every Warden is asked at every trigger (removed with every local model, #438).

**wilsonInterval**  
95% Wilson interval for n successes in d trials.

## 1. What this Warden covers

The eval machinery that scores Wardens against real sessions (probes, labels, judges, scores, cost weights and the experiment gate), and the rule that no pre-filter decides which Wardens are asked: every Warden is asked at every trigger.

## 2. The domain

There is no Warden pre-filter. Every Warden is asked at every trigger point that reaches it, on the decision model (Claude Haiku). A local-model pre-filter (WardenPrefilter, Kev-4B on a loopback System One server) was built, measured, switched off on 2026-10-15 because no local model cleared 80% recall at a skip rate worth its latency, and removed with every local model provider on 2026-11-19 (R-2026-11-19-04, #438); the measurements are in Oracle `docs/WARDEN-EXPERIMENTS.md`. A wish to ask fewer Wardens is answered by that rule, not by a keyword, path or model filter.

The eval side: runCharterEval runs probes built from real sessions (the user's own correction is ground truth), one turn per trigger with every Warden asked at once, composed exactly as a live thread composes them, then judges each remark (judge, wardenJudgeMessage / wardenPointerJudgeMessage, parseWardenJudgement / parseWardenPointerJudgement). Correction targets are labelled (correctionTargetMessages, parseCorrectionTargets) and canonicalized (targetCanonicalMessages, parseTargetCanonical); scoreCharterRun scores a run in foundry-core so Oracle scores the same way; readClassifyRun loads a classify run config; kindWeighted / modelWeighted give cost; wilsonInterval gives intervals; requireExperiment blocks a wide run without a passing design; markEvalRun keeps eval runs out of Archive and repeat reports. Source fetchers (fetchLinearItems, fetchReviewedPrs, sessionEvidence) gather reviewer comments as correction sources.

Not here: the charter text, stages and answer parsers the eval exercises are `classify`; when Wardens are asked at each trigger is `warden-triggers`; the chorus setting and region Wardens are `chorus`; the Prospector correction detector and `foundry repeats` are `feedback`; TypeSafe's client is `typesafe`; the decision host evals run on (decisionHost) is `decision-hosts`.

## 4. The specifics, in full

### 4a. Doc sections

Each unit is the doc section verbatim, with its headings shifted down two levels. A source line above it gives the path, the section and the doc's H1.

<!-- unit doc:docs/subscription-decisions.md#no-warden-pre-filter -->
**Source:** `docs/subscription-decisions.md` § No Warden pre-filter (in "Subscription-only Foundry")

#### No Warden pre-filter

Every Warden is asked at every trigger point that reaches it, on the decision model (Claude Haiku). A local-model pre-filter that skipped a Warden on a confident "not my domain" was built, measured and switched off on 2026-10-15 (no local model cleared 80% recall at a skip rate worth its latency: Kev-4B added 4–4.6 s before any Warden could start, Kev-0.8B and ModernBERT barely beat chance; the measurements are in Oracle `docs/WARDEN-EXPERIMENTS.md`). It was removed with every local model provider (Ollama, vLLM) on 2026-11-19 (R-2026-11-19-04, Aron: "Get rid of all these local models. We're not using them anymore. We're on Haiku."), so `foundry-acp setup` downloads no model and the daemon serves none.
